item.title: Burlington wins triple-overtime thriller, advances to 3A championship game
item.description: HUTCHINSON (KSNT) - It was a thriller in Hutchinson. Burlington's Troy Over hit a game-winning shot as time expired to lift No. 3 Burlington over No. 2 Hesston 77-76 in a triple-overtime thriller. Over had 16 points in the win.
